mapper.select: SELECT sm.menu_perm FROM sys_menu sm LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm ON sm.menu_id = srm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.role_id = srm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur ON sur.role_id = sr.role_id WHERE sm.menu_type = 'BUTTON' AND sur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT su.*, sug.copms_list FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN sys_user_grid sug ON sug.user_id = su.user_id WHERE su.username = #{accessKey}
